shared_elements: bird-like creature with prominent beak/head in profile
incised parallel lines rendering wing or feather texture
crouching/squatting anthropomorphic figure with arms brought forward
justification: Both stack a large beaked bird-like head with hatched wing/feather incisions above a smaller crouching anthropomorphic figure in a vertical sequence on pale coarse limestone, and both share the same blunt, schematic treatment of heads and limbs. The decisive difference is medium and format: A is a flat slab covered in shallow relief and incised bands read as registers, whereas B is a fully three-dimensional, deeply undercut sculpture in the round with no ornamental banding.
